notes: Posted 6 November 2001, before Theed Palace, so the format is Premiere - Reflections III; every card is from Reflections III or earlier (the Theed Palace Generator sites are the Reflections III printings).
Byline 'Darth Vader "The Dark" Lord of The Sith' is a character name, so the deck is credited to the handle The Dark with no player page.

Starting cards as posted at the top of the list: We'll Handle This / Duel Of The Fates, Naboo: Theed Palace Generator, Naboo: Theed Palace Generator Core, Inner Strength, An Unusual Amount Of Fear, Prepared Defenses (see below), Insurrection & Aim High, Do, Or Do Not & Wise Advice and Menace Fades; these count toward the 60.
Posted 'Prepared Defenses' (a Dark card) dested the Light starting interrupt Heading For The Medical Frigate, which this author starts in his other Duel Of The Fates list.

Posted 'Do Or Do Not & Wise Advice' dested Do, Or Do Not & Wise Advice; 'Insurrection & Aim High' dested the combo Effect Insurrection & Aim High; 'Theed Palace Docking Bay' dested the Light Naboo: Theed Palace Docking Bay.

Posted 'Chewbacca, Enraged' dested Chewie, Enraged; 'Owen & Beru Lars' dested Owen Lars & Beru Lars; 'Padme Nebarrie' dested Padme Naberrie; 'Tallon Karrde' dested Talon Karrde; 'Punch It' dested Punch It!; 'Run Luke, Run' dested Run Luke, Run!; 'Home One Docking Bay' dested Home One: Docking Bay.
Anakin Skywalker under Interrupts is the Death Star II Used Interrupt; Projection Of A Skywalker (an Effect) is also posted under Interrupts.
Section headers say Weapons (4) and Interrupts (14), but 6 weapons and 16 interrupts are listed; the list totals 60 as published.
